ideas.idea: Explain/substantiate the 'thousands of local patients' claim with evidence
ideas.why: Content-quality advice that applies to any site and is not a technical discoverability fix.

ideas.idea: Publish actual prices on the services page or link to a price list
ideas.why: services.njk says 'Our prices are simple and clear' but lists no prices, so users and machines cannot find them.

ideas.idea: Add dentist names, credentials and expertise profiles to the team page
ideas.why: team.njk has only a vague line about 'decades of experience', so named profiles would add real, extractable content.

ideas.idea: Describe emergency care with hours, eligibility and booking instructions
ideas.why: The homepage only says 'Emergency appointments available' with no details, and emergency care is a key service.

ideas.idea: Give important treatments dedicated pages linked from services
ideas.why: Services is a bare four-item list with no detail pages, so dedicated pages would give each treatment a findable URL and content.

ideas.idea: Add Open Graph and Twitter card metadata to base.njk
ideas.why: Accurate, since base.njk has no such tags, but it only affects share previews and would apply to almost any site.

ideas.idea: Add address and contact details to valid Dentist JSON-LD on contact page
ideas.why: The visible address '12 Park Row, Leeds' is missing from the Dentist JSON-LD, which only has name and telephone.
